policies.name: studio_head_owner
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM studio.projects p
  WHERE (p.project_id = asset_heads.project_id)))
policies.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM studio.projects p
  WHERE (p.project_id = asset_heads.project_id)))

policies.name: studio_link_owner
policies.qual:
((EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM studio.projects p
  WHERE (p.project_id = asset_links.project_id))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM studio.asset_revisions r
  WHERE (r.revision_id = asset_links.source_revision_id))))
policies.with_check:
((EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM studio.projects p
  WHERE (p.project_id = asset_links.project_id))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM studio.asset_revisions r
  WHERE (r.revision_id = asset_links.source_revision_id))))

policies.name: studio_revision_owner
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM studio.asset_heads h
  WHERE (h.asset_id = asset_revisions.asset_id)))
policies.with_check:
((actor_id = ( SELECT control.current_app_user_id() AS current_app_user_id)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM studio.asset_heads h
  WHERE (h.asset_id = asset_revisions.asset_id))) AND ((delegation_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM (studio.delegations d
     JOIN studio.asset_heads h ON ((h.project_id = d.project_id)))
  WHERE ((d.delegation_id = asset_revisions.delegation_id) AND (h.asset_id = asset_revisions.asset_id))))) AND ((external_receipt_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM studio.execution_receipts r
  WHERE ((r.receipt_id = asset_revisions.external_receipt_id) AND (r.delegation_id = asset_revisions.delegation_id))))))

policies.name: studio_delegation_owner
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM studio.projects p
  WHERE (p.project_id = delegations.project_id)))
policies.with_check:
((requester = ( SELECT control.current_app_user_id() AS current_app_user_id)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM studio.projects p
  WHERE (p.project_id = delegations.project_id))))

policies.name: studio_execution_event_owner
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM studio.execution_controls c
  WHERE (c.delegation_id = execution_control_events.delegation_id)))

policies.name: studio_execution_owner
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM (studio.delegations d
     JOIN studio.projects p USING (project_id))
  WHERE ((d.delegation_id = execution_controls.delegation_id) AND (p.owner_user_id = ( SELECT control.current_app_user_id() AS current_app_user_id)) AND (p.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE'::text))))

policies.name: studio_receipt_owner
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM studio.delegations d
  WHERE (d.delegation_id = execution_receipts.delegation_id)))
policies.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM studio.delegations d
  WHERE (d.delegation_id = execution_receipts.delegation_id)))

policies.qual:
(project_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ((c.allowed_scope ->> 'project_id'::text))::uuid AS uuid
   FROM control.gate_candidates c
  WHERE ((c.consumer = 'producer'::text) AND (c.candidate_status = 'SUBMITTED'::text))))

  WHERE ((p.project_id = private_originals.project_id) AND (p.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE'::text)))))

views.name: meaning_eligibility
views.definition:
SELECT object_type,
    object_id,
    gate_audit_id,
    purpose,
    allowed_scope,
    consumer,
    effective_time
   FROM control.gate_audits g
  WHERE ((gate_code = 'G4'::text) AND (result = 'PASS'::control.gate_result) AND (current_valid = true));

views.name: world_eligibility
views.definition:
SELECT object_type,
    object_id,
    gate_audit_id,
    purpose,
    allowed_scope,
    consumer,
    effective_time
   FROM control.gate_audits g
  WHERE ((gate_code = 'G3'::text) AND (result = 'PASS'::control.gate_result) AND (current_valid = true));
